name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px solid #004494 focus ring with a 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity. This keeps the ring visible against dark backgrounds while ensuring it doesn’t blend into light ones, improving keyboard navigation for users with low vision or motor impairments. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings, but the clarity outweighs the minimal extra space they take.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring risks visual clutter on dense UIs and may still fade on #f8f9fa backgrounds where #004494’s contrast drops 3.1:1. A 2px #005fcc ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity meets WCAG 2.1 AA on both dark and light modes while staying compact. Test both in high-contrast mode and dark mode—if either fails, pick the 2px version.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity. It meets WCAG 2.1 AA on both dark and light backgrounds, avoids visual clutter on dense UIs, and stays compact for mobile/touch users. The trade-off is slightly lower visibility on very dark backgrounds, but the 3.1:1 contrast on #f8f9fa and 4.5:1 on #000000 keeps it usable for low-vision users. Test in high-contrast mode to confirm.

name: Reader
text: The 2px #005fcc ring risks disappearing entirely on #000000 backgrounds where its contrast drops to 2.1:1—below WCAG AA. A 3px #005fcc ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity hits 4.5:1 on both extremes, solving the fade-out without bulk. Test both in high-contrast mode and dark mode—if the 3px version passes, adopt it.

name: Access
